atAGlance: Lẩu cá tầm is sturgeon hot pot, usually with firm fish, sour broth, vegetables, and noodles.
whatItIs: Lẩu cá tầm is sturgeon hot pot, often with a sour broth, herbs, greens, tomatoes, pineapple or tamarind, and noodles. The fish is firm and clean-tasting.
howToEnjoy: Cook sturgeon pieces gently and watch for bones or cartilage. Add herbs and noodles in stages so the sour broth stays bright.
howLocalsOrder: Order lẩu cá tầm as a shared hot pot, especially in highland or cooler-weather settings. Ask for less spicy broth, extra herbs, or bone guidance.
worthKnowing: Cá tầm, sturgeon, is especially associated with cooler highland destinations like Đà Lạt and Sa Pa in traveler menus.
goodToKnow: Sturgeon can have firm flesh and cartilage-rich pieces. Add greens and noodles after the fish has warmed through.
